shipping.note: Shipping is ₹/kg based on your location and order weight — ₹80/kg within Karnataka, ₹100/kg for South India, ₹180/kg for remote/Northeast regions, ₹130/kg for the rest of India. Dispatched in 2–4 business days; delivery 3–8 business days. Prepaid only — no cash on delivery.

booking.note: This is a booking ENQUIRY only — our artist will confirm availability, exact pricing and travel charges with you directly.
booking.leadTimeNote: Please enquire at least 7 days before your event date for bridal bookings.
